paragraphs: The Discovery HSE is a trim level rather than a distinct engine variant — it can carry several different engines across the D3 and D4 generations. From 2004 to 2016, a Discovery HSE could have a TDV6, SDV6, Si6, TDV8, or SDV8 depending on specification and model year. The HSE badge indicates the top-spec trim, not a specific engine code, which is why matching your exact engine by registration is essential before any work is quoted or carried out. The Discovery 4 (D4) facelift was produced from 2009 to 2016, and the HSE trim was available with the same range of engines across both generations.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8, or Si6 engines for every Discovery HSE on the road.
